Copy as Markdown
Copy this page as markdown to use with AI assistants
View as Markdown 
Open this page as markdown in a new tab
Zoho Inventory provides APIs to retrieve lists of contacts, plans and other resources - paginated to 200 items by default. The pagination information will be included in the list API response under the node name 
page_context
.
By default first page will be listed. For navigating through pages, use the 
page
 parameter.
The 
per_page
 parameter can be used to set the number of records that you want to receive in response.
 Request Example 
Click to copy 
$ 
curl
 https://www.zohoapis.com/inventory/v1/contacts?page
=
2
&
per_page
=
25
Response Example
{
"code"
:
0
,
"message"
:
"success"
,
"contacts"
:
[
{
...
}
,
{
...
}
]
,
"page_context"
:
{
"page"
:
2
,
"per_page"
:
25
,
"has_more_page"
:
false
}
}
${resultObj.description}
